description: Set the agent's webhook URL / event types / enabled. Requires confirm: true.

confirm.description: Required true: changes where the agent's events are sent.

enabled.description: Whether deliveries are active. REQUIRED — this is a whole-state PUT; read the current config first to preserve the existing enabled state.

event_types.description: Event types to deliver; null/omitted = all available types.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint to deliver agent events to.

name: xenarch_set_agent_webhook
